title: Heritage Family Restaurant
textTranslated: After several hours' drive to Adam's Peak, we stopped in the middle of the afternoon for lunch. We received a very warm welcome, always with a smile! The small roadside restaurant is surprisingly charming, offering a lovely view overlooking the river and excellent local food! After chatting, we learned they also offer treehouse accommodation, which seemed like a good option for those who want to break up the drive into two stages or simply enjoy the area.
text:
Après plusieurs heures de route vers Adam’s Peak, nous nous sommes arrêté en plein après midi pour déjeuner. Nous avons été très bien reçu, toujours avec le sourire ! Le petit restaurant en bord de route cache bien son jeu, il offre une vu surplombant la rivière très agréable et une nourriture local de qualité!
Après discussion il propose aussi un hébergement type maison dans les arbres qui nous paraît également être une bonne option pour ceux qui souhaitent faire le trajet en deux étapes ou pour profiter du lieu.

title: Heritage Family Restaurant
text:
The place was just a fluke hit as we got tired of waiting at an earlier place. We were pretty fortunate to find it as it was a gem. On a platform with the river underneath you was plenty awesome.
There was only one guy when we went there (5pm on a Monday evening) but he was pretty efficient.
We ordered one fish fried rice for 3 people as we were not really hungry. The portion was enormous and he brought 2 extra plates without telling, a plus point.
We also ordered lime juice (again decently priced).
My wife tried the restroom and said that it was in perfect condition - a compliment from a picky person.
So yeah, I'm giving you the 5 stars. Deserve it
responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind feedback

title: Heritage Family Restaurant
text:
Nestled among the serene mountains, this restaurant is a charming little place that offers a variety of local food from kottu to rice. We stopped here on our way back from a trip to a nearby waterfall. The restaurant has a rustic ambience, which adds to the overall experience. It overlooks a river and is manned by just one person who acts as the waiter and the chef. But in spite of this, the service was extremely fast.
The server was a lovely young man who was super friendly and welcoming. We could see him making the dishes we ordered, and he adhered to all the food hygiene precautions.
The taste was amazing, I would 100% go back for the chicken kottu.
The quick, attentive service and beautiful views make it a must visit for people who travel along this route.
name: Jilva Rasheed
